book.name: San Mateo
book.title: Dill' wen dill' kob daa bzej Matewa'

content: Jesúza' chawe' xya c̱he fariseoka' na' beṉ'ka' chli' chsedi leya'
Na'ch Jesúza' golle' beṉ'ka' nakgake'ne' txen len beṉ'ka' lle' na', chi'e:
―Beṉ'ka' chli' chsedi leya' na' fariseoka' nak lo na'gake' wzajni'gakile' beṉ' daa bzej dii Moiséza'.
Na' chiyaḻ' wzenagle c̱hegake' kat' chzajni'gakile' le' leya' na' gonle ka nan. Per bi gonle ka chongake', ḻa' ḻegake' bi chongake' ka nagake' chiyaḻ' gonle.
Dii zan dii che'gake' beṉ' chiyaḻ' gongake', na' nakan ka to yoa' xen dii chwa'gake' beṉ' dii kono so saki, na' ḻegake' bikz bi chda na'gake' kwenc̱he gaklengake'.

Na' yog' diika' chongake' chongake'n kwenc̱hezə ile'i beṉ' ka chongake' na' we'la'ogake' ḻegake'. Na' kajdo'ka' nak de yid daa yoo lat' Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' daa chda' loxgue'ka' na' daa chc̱heḻ neeka' chongake'n dii xench aga ka c̱he beṉ' yoblə, na' chtoṉchgake' lox xe'ka' aga ka c̱he beṉ' yoblə.
Na' kat' chajgake' lṉika', ḻe chibagakile' kwe'gake' gana' chbe' beṉ'ka' zakii, na' ḻekzka'yeṉ' chjengake' gana' chdop chllaggake' choe'ḻwillgake' Chioza'.
Na' ḻe chibagakile' gap beṉ' ḻegake' balaaṉ kat' chillaggake' ḻegake' ga lle' lla' beṉ' na' ye'gake' ḻegake': “maestro”.
’San le', bi we'le latj iṉa beṉ' le' “maestro”, ḻa' toz nadaan nak' Maestro c̱hele na' yog'le nakle ka bish' ljwellin.
Na' kono ye'le “x̱a” lo yell-lioni, ḻa' toz Chioza', beena' zoa yabana', nake' X̱ale.
Ni bi we'le latj iṉagake' le' “maestro”, ḻa' toz nad', Cristo, nak' Maestro c̱hele.
Ḻa' beena' nak beṉ' gax̱jlall' na' chaklene', beenan' nake' beṉ' zak'chi ladjlena'.
Na' beena' chon kwine' beṉ' zakii, Chioza' gone'ne' beṉ' bibi zakii. Na' beena' chon kwine' ka beṉ' bibi zakii, Chioza' gone'ne' beṉ' zakii.

’¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' chli' chsedile' leya' na' le' fariseo, daa nakle beṉ' wxiye'! Ḻa' chsej chllonle gombia' beṉ' yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱he Chioza', na' ni bi choe'le latj iṉabi'e le', ni bi choe'le latj c̱he beṉ'ka' cheengakile' iṉabi'e ḻegake'.

’¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' chli' chsedile' leya' na' le' fariseo, daa nakle beṉ' wxiye'! Ḻa' chkaale lill nool wizebka' na' choe'ḻwill-le Chioza' ssha nlleb kwenc̱he gaki beṉ' nakle beṉ' wen. Na' daa chonle ka', Chioza' wsak'zi'che' le' aga ka beṉ' yoblə.

’¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' chli' chsedile' leya' na' le' fariseo, daa nakle beṉ' wxiye'! Chdale to ni to na' chyiljle beṉ' wsede' daa chli' chsedile. Na' kat' chllelilene' chónlene' beṉ' malch aga ka le' na' chlliayi'chlene' ax̱t c̱hoplə ka to ba mbiayi'le.

’¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' nakle ka beṉ' lc̱hoḻ, beṉ' chakile' wak wc̱hi'e sto beṉ' lc̱hoḻ! Ḻa' nale: “Shi to beṉ' wc̱hebe' to dii gone' na' wzoe' yoodo'na' de tasc̱hiw kwenc̱he gone' daa bc̱hebe', bi chonan byen gone'n.” Na' chiznale: “Shi wzoe' de tasc̱hiw ora' daa de ḻoo yoodo'na', na'chan chiyaḻ' gone' daa bc̱hebe'.”
¡Le' nakle ka beṉ' lc̱hoḻ daa bi nteyile! ¿Abi chakbe'ile zak'ch yoodo'na' aga ka ora'? Ḻa' yoodo'nan' chonan kwenc̱he ora' de ḻo'inna' nakan c̱he Chios.

Na' ḻekzka' chiznale: “Shi to beṉ' wc̱hebe' to dii gone' na' wzoe' de tasc̱hiw gana' chzeygake' bayix̱'ka' chitgake' kwenc̱he choe'la'ogake' Chioza', bi chonan byen gone' daa bc̱hebe'. Per shi wzoe' de tasc̱hiw bayix̱aa chx̱oagake' lawinna', na'chan chiyaḻ' gone' daa bc̱hebe'.”

¡Le' nakle ka beṉ' lc̱hoḻ daa bi chajniile! ¿Abi chakbe'ile' gana' chzeygake' bayix̱aa chzanile we'le Chioza' zak'chan aga ka bayix̱aa chzeygake' lawinna'?, ḻa' gana' chzeygake'b chonan ḻeb ba c̱he Chios.
Ḻa' beena' chc̱heb wi'e to dii wi'e na' chzoe' de tasc̱hiw gana' chzeygake'b, aga toz ḻennan' chzoe' de tasc̱hiw, san ḻekzka' len yog' daa xoa lawinnan'.
Na' beena' chc̱heb wi'e to dii wi'e na' chzoe' de tasc̱hiw yoodo'na', aga toz yoodo'nan' chzoe' de tasc̱hiw, san ḻekzka' len Chiozan' daa nakan lill xḻatje'.
Na' ḻekzka' beena' chc̱heb wi'e to dii wi'e na' chzoe' de tasc̱hiw yabana', aga toz yabanan' chzoe' de tasc̱hiw, san len Chiozan' daa nakan gana' chṉabi'e.

’¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' chli' chsedile leya' na' le' fariseo, daa nakle beṉ' wxiye'! Choe'le Chioza' diézmona' ax̱t len yix̱weja', aníza', na' cominna', per bi chonle daa llialotech daa nllia Chioza' bia' goncho. Dii llialotech goncho daa nak shḻi, yiyesh'lallicho beṉ', na' gonḻilall'cho Chioza' do yic̱hj do lall'cho. Diikin chiyaḻ' gonle, per ḻekzka' bi chiyaḻ' wsanle gonle diika' sto.
¡Le' nakle ka to beṉ' lc̱hoḻ beṉ' chakile' wak wc̱hi'e sto beṉ' lc̱hoḻ! Na' chonle ka to beṉ' chone' byen chibeje' to bi'a lesdo' ḻoo yeḻ' wao c̱he'na' na' bi chakbe'ile' chebe' to kamey.

’¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' chli' chsedile leya' na' le' fariseo, daa nakle beṉ' wxiye'! Nakle ka xig' yeeṉ dii nxi nyech kolliinna' per ḻo'inna' bi nxe bi nzak' nakan, daa chonle ka chaki beṉ' nakle beṉ' wen per ḻe chzelall'le bi dii de c̱he beṉ' na' chbanlen.
Na' le' fariseo, ¡nakle ka beṉ' lc̱hoḻ daa bi chajniile! Ḻi yiyaj yileni daa chonle kwenc̱he gakle beṉ' wen ka chaki beṉ' nakle, na'ch gakle ka xig' yeeṉ dii nxi nyech ka ḻoolə ka koll'lin.

’¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' chli' chsedile leya' na' le' fariseo, daa nakle beṉ' wxiye'! Ḻa' nakle ka to lill beṉ' wet dii nyebgake' yiw' na' nḻa' lawinna' xochi, per ḻo'inna' lle' lla'n llit wetka' na' bichlə dii zban.
Kan' nakle le' daa chonle ka chaki beṉ' nakle beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' per ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'lena' lle' lla'n de wxiye' na' dii mal.

’¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱hele, le' chli' chsedile leya' na' le' fariseo, daa nakle beṉ' wxiye'! Chonshao'zle gana' bkwash'gake' dii beṉ'ka' wdix̱jee daa goll Chioza' ḻegake' kani'yi, na' chonle xochi gana' bkwash'gake' nochlə beṉ'ka' gok beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao'.
Na' nale: “Sheḻ'ka' neto' ba zoanto' kana' wzoa dii x̱ozxto'nto'ka' aga bennto' ḻegake' txen ka betgake' dii beṉ'ka' wdix̱jee daa goll Chioza' ḻegake'.”
Per kwinzkzlen chli'le nakle toz beṉ'ka' betgake' dii beṉ'ka' wdix̱jee daa goll Chioza' ḻegake' kani'yi, ḻa' toz ka chonlenle ḻegake'.
¡Na' ḻi yisyoll ḻi yisto ḻi gon dii mala' daa bi biyoll gon dii x̱ozxto'leka'!
’¡Le' nakle ka beḻ zṉia! Bi gakile shi wilale lo yi' gabiḻa'.

Daan wseḻaa beṉ' c̱hix̱je'gakile' le' daa yepgakee. Wseḻaa beṉ' sin' beṉ' chajnii kwenc̱he wli' wsedgakile' le' cho'a xtillaana'. Per baḻgake' witle, na' baḻgake' wda'le ḻee yag cruza', na' baḻgake' wit c̱hinle gana' chdop chllagle choe'ḻwill-le Chioza', na' zi baḻgake' lljalagle to to yellka' gana' illingake'.

Na' daa gonle ka', yidobile yeḻ' wit c̱he yog'ḻoḻ beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao'ka' bet dii x̱ozxto'leka', wzolozin dii Abela' beena' gok beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao', ax̱t dii Zacaríaza', xiiṉ Berequíaza', beena' betgake' latja' daa de cho'a yoodo'na', kwit gana' chzeygake' bayix̱'ka'.
Dii ḻi nia' le', ka le' zoale ṉaa chidoḻ'le sak'zi'le c̱he yog' daa ben dii x̱ozxto'leka'.
Jesúza' gokyeshile' c̱he beṉ' Jerusalénka'

’¡Le' beṉ' Jerusalén, le' chitle beṉ'ka' chyix̱jee daa che' Chioza' ḻegake', na' chlliale yaj beṉ'ka' chseḻee c̱hix̱je'gakile' le' cho'a xtilleena'! ¡Zan shii goklallaa gon' c̱hele ka chon jeda' chiyellb xiiṉdo'bka' xan x̱ilba', na' bi goklall'le!
Na' ṉaa ba wlej yic̱hj Chioza' le', na' gani lle'le idesh iloan.
Na' nia' le', bich ile'ile nad' ax̱t kat'ch illin lla iṉale: “¡Gaklenshga X̱ancho Chioza' beeni ba bseḻee!”
